translations.answer: Compare nconmax and use_mujoco_contacts in the same environment to confirm if the issue is with the CollisionPipeline, not with the Whole-Body Control (WBC). The fix for this Issue has been integrated into the main branch of Newton PR #2112; temporary switching of MuJoCo contacts is recommended, but should not solely raise the illegal_contact threshold.
translations.applicability: Applies to the corresponding version of Newton/Isaac Lab CollisionPipeline; the issue should still be reproducible with the upgraded contact handling.
translations.credibility.rationale: The environment, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent reproduction is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: Temporarily raise the illegal_contact threshold and switch to use_mujoco_contacts=True.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Compare use_mujoco_contacts switch, nconmax, and illegal_contact threshold to isolate the contact pipeline.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: The fix has been integrated into the main branch of Newton PR #2112. The maintainer confirmed the fix is in the main branch.
translations.details.environments.0: Isaac Lab, Newton CollisionPipeline, MJWarpSolverCfg, Anymal-C flat speed environment.
translations.details.limits.0: The actual Newton/Isaac Lab version should be recorded; older versions may still require temporary switching of the contact backend.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The comment confirms that the main branch contains the fix.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: The robot terminates immediately after increasing nconmax due to false base contact force.
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Do not use raising the illegal_contact threshold as a sole solution to mask abnormal contact force and directly migrate to real machine without validation.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The CollisionPipeline has incorporated an unnecessary contact in high contact capacity scenarios.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Only overflow warning when nconmax ≤ 16; abnormal contact force reaches an extremely high level when nconmax = 32.
translations.source.title: Newton CollisionPipeline: nconmax Increase Triggers False Contact Force
translations.title: False Contact Force Appears After Increasing nconmax in Newton; How to Diagnose?
